title: CAT 2025 Question Paper (Slot 2, PYQ) - QA - Averages
subject: QA

questions.q: The average number of copies of a book sold per day by a shopkeeper is 60 in the initial seven days and 63 in the initial eight days, after the book launch. On the ninth day, she sells 11 copies less than the eighth day, and the average number of copies sold per day from second day to ninth day becomes 66. The number of copies sold on the first day of the book launch is
questions.explain:
Total copies sold in the first 7 days = $60 \times 7 = 420$.
Total copies sold in the first 8 days = $63 \times 8 = 504$.
Copies sold on the 8th day = $504 - 420 = 84$.
Copies sold on the 9th day = $84 - 11 = 73$.
Total copies sold in 9 days = $504 + 73 = 577$.
The average sold from day 2 to day 9 is 66, which spans 8 days.
Total copies from day 2 to day 9 = $66 \times 8 = 528$.
Therefore, copies sold on day 1 = (Total for 9 days) - (Total for days 2 to 9) = $577 - 528 = 49$.
